purpose: Reproducible screening only; native balance and win rates remain unverified.
assumptions: Native Feudal-age automatically reachable bonuses and explicit Chinese/Turk startup grants are inventoried.
Armour and attack bonus classes, Leitis melee-armour bypass, ordinary accuracy, reduced secondary projectile damage, simple melee frontage and finite range lead-in are screened.
Mixed-team screening includes distinct 1v1, 2v2 and 4v4 lineups with simultaneous damage and four-Castle replacements.

Native team bonuses, manually researched upgrades, hero tiers, Castle fire, micro, terrain/pathfinding, dismounts, armour stripping, reflection, most new charge/ability types and perfect kiting are not reproduced.
Where simplified screen disagrees with live gameplay, live evidence takes priority; Spanish/Saracen corrections and Lithuanian strengthening are explicit empirical decisions.
Newer and special-mechanic civilizations retain deployed pacing pending native playtests; all 62 have explicit reviewed decisions.
